name: 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gas S.A.
summary: 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gás S.A. engages in the exploration and production of oil and natural gas in Brazil. The company operates seven fields located in the Potiguar Basin, Rio Grande do Norte; hold a 35% interest in the rights of concession of the fields of Pescada, Arabaiana, and Dentão located in the Potiguar Basin; and holds interest in Polo Rio Ventura, which includes 8 fields located in the Recôncavo Basin in the state of Bahia. 3R Petroleum Óleo e Gás S.A. was founded in 2010 and is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
